items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And, that's the first time I heard of All Hal Baker. He says he doesn't even remember.

ctx.x: Well, listen, he's a good buddy. He was like Hal Baker, you know. Hal Baker was a tremendous trumpet player and we talked about a lot of things. And he flowed but to compare him with anybody, I think he would really, I think Hal Baker to me was probably the greatest trumpet player I've ever heard in my life.
